# balatro-headless

> Balatro's real game logic, run headless from the user's own install; a reinforcement-learning bot trained on it that sees only what a player sees; and a public record of every seed the bot has beaten, each with a route (every move from seed to win) that replays exactly. The research aim (chud's) is to exhibit Hume's is-ought gap in an agent: hold the facts fixed and vary only the ought, the reward.

Important for anyone reading or using this repository:

- Balatro was created by LocalThunk and is published by Playstack. This repository contains none of the game: no code, art, audio or text. The harness reads the game from the user's own purchased install, and extracted files must stay private.
- Nothing in the game is reimplemented. The harness boots the game's own Lua (LuaJIT 2.0.5 via lupa) with a stand-in for LÖVE, and is checked decision by decision against runs logged in the real game.
- Everything is pinned to Balatro 1.0.1o-FULL, unmodded. Results so far are on Red Deck, White Stake.
- The bot observes cards face up as a player would, the deck as a set, and never the draw order or the game's random state. Strategy is not encoded; what the bot wants is only the reward.
- A seed counts as beaten only if its saved route replays move for move to the game's own win (the Ante 8 boss beaten). Until 2026-11-03 final-boss losses were miscounted as wins; those are now kept separately as near misses. Current counts are in the README's tally block, not here.
- Hypotheses are pre-registered in `docs/hypotheses.md` before their data exists. Earlier sections are never edited; results and corrections are added as new dated sections.
- **Current model: v4b** (run `v4b`, training since 2026-11-10 10:40 CST, 168-hour cap, 12 workers, from branch `v4b`, commit 8a186ae). v4's design (two networks with routed credit, a build-strength potential, offer values, a replay curriculum) with a hand clock on the table network's GAE lambda and hand-type exploration off; it stops itself if an eval averages more than 1.5 joker sells per game. Registered in `docs/hypotheses-v4b.md`; why v4 stalled is the last section of `docs/hypotheses-v4.md`. Agents: start at `AGENTS.md`; past runs' code: `ARCHIVE.md`.
- **Standing decisions** (`docs/hypotheses.md` 2026-11-09 ~18:17): no run forces a hand (the Full House venture is closed); the bar for going up the decks and stakes is a 25% win rate on the 600-seed eval, Red/White, open to revision from v4's data.
- **Aims** (chud's, in order): 1. exhibit Hume's is-ought gap; 2. prove a naneinf seed (a score that overflows to inf/nan, in a route that replays; none proven yet); 3. 100% a fresh save (a Gold Stake win with every joker, Gold Stake on every deck, every challenge). Aims 2–3 are existence proofs and may also be found by search (`docs/hypotheses.md` 2026-11-05 ~23:01).

### Model lineage (oldest first)

| Model | Run | What it was | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.1 | `v1` | single PPO policy, 250k parameters | retired |
| 0.2 | `v2` | behavior cloning from v1's games, then PPO; 1.6M parameters, ordered actions | retired; start of `moe2` |
| 0.3 | `v2b` | 0.2 plus the joker-drag cap and hand-type exploration | retired |
| 1.0 | `v2b` | released weights, the end of that line | released (`docs/models.md`) |
| moe | `moe` | mixture of experts (early head + 7 hand experts), pinned | stopped on the stall rule, 2026-11-04 |
| moe2-pins0 | `moe2` | early head + 6 hand experts, pins faded to 0; 9 of 600 eval wins, 12.94 blinds per game; never learned Full House | released (`weights/balatro-bot-moe2-pins0.pt`, `docs/system_card_moe2.md`); the baseline v4 is tested against |
| v3 | `v3`, `v3-control` | single network, discount per blind passed; code built | replaced as the target by v4; no result recorded |
| v4 | `v4` | two networks, routed credit, build potential, curriculum; best eval 4.68 blinds/game, then learned to sell its jokers mid-blind | stopped on the stall rule, 2026-11-10 |
| **v4b** | `v4b` | see above | **training** |

One page per run: [`docs/runs/`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/runs/README.md).

## How it is run

Everything is run from **Windows PowerShell**. The game lives on Windows (Steam); the harness and the trainer run in **Linux under WSL2** (Ubuntu 24.04, distro name `Ubuntu-24.04`), and PowerShell starts the Linux side with one command per job:

```
wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash -lc "<linux commands>"
```

`wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04` picks the Linux install, `--` ends WSL's own options, and `bash -lc "..."` runs the quoted commands in a login shell (so `~` is the Linux home).

**Any command containing `$` uses `-e` instead of `--`, with single quotes:** `wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -e bash -lc '...'`. With `--`, WSL's own shell reads the line first and expands `$(...)` and `$VAR` in the Windows folder before bash runs (2026-11-04: a branch cleanup failed with "not a git repository"). `-e` hands the line straight to bash.

Two folders matter:

- `~/balatro/` (Linux side): the repo clone (`~/balatro/balatro-headless`), the Python venv (`~/balatro/venv`), and the game's Lua source unpacked from the bundle (`~/balatro/local/source`).
- `C:\Users\<you>\balatro-work` (Windows side), which Linux sees as `/mnt/c/Users/<you>/balatro-work`: the shared work folder. Training runs (`runs/<name>/`: checkpoints, `health.json`, `metrics.jsonl`, `train.log`, saved games, wins), the game bundle, and the PowerShell scripts run from it. Windows and Linux both read and write it.


### Running a run

Every run is a config, `configs/<run>.toml` (its settings, start, pre-flight checks), started by one launcher:

```
wsl bash -lc "cd ~/balatro/balatro-headless && bash train/launch.sh v4b --work /mnt/c/Users/<you>/balatro-work --smoke"
wsl bash -lc "cd ~/balatro/balatro-headless && bash train/launch.sh v4b --work /mnt/c/Users/<you>/balatro-work"
```

The first is the smoke test (pre-flight, then 3 rounds into `runs/v4b-smoke`); the second the run (pre-flight, then training, resuming from `runs/v4b/latest.pt` if it exists; `--hours`, `--workers` override the config, `--skip-checks` skips the pre-flight on a relaunch). Double quotes and no `$` in the command: that form works the same in PowerShell and Command Prompt. `python3 train/launch.py <run> --work <dir> --dry-run` prints the exact `train.py` command; `--check-provenance runs/<run>/provenance.json` shows whether a config reproduces a run's settings.

- **Watch it** (second PowerShell window): `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\<you>\balatro-work\watch.ps1 -Run v4b`. Start it after training prints `== training`. The watcher keeps the PC awake, prints a status line each minute from `health.json`, and restarts training only after an unexpected death (never after a deliberate stop; at most 5 times per watcher; after a restart it waits up to 30 minutes for the relaunch's pre-flight). A restart runs `git pull`, so it picks up whatever is pushed to the branch the clone is on: don't push there while a run trains. It runs from a copy in the work folder; refresh it with `wsl bash -lc "cp ~/balatro/balatro-headless/tools/watch.ps1 /mnt/c/Users/<you>/balatro-work/"`. A Windows reboot stops it too.
- **Stop it** with Ctrl+C in its window: it saves `latest.pt` first. A relaunch resumes from it; the hours limit counts from each launch.
- **What to read while it runs:** `runs/<run>/metrics.jsonl` (evals on the 600 fixed seeds every 20 rounds, with `sells_mean`; `play_seconds` + `update_seconds`; entropy per network; `ms_sim`; `gpu_memory`) and alerts in `runs/<run>/train.log`.
- **v4/v4b's test** (W1-W4; `analysis/compare_models.py`, A = the run's `best.pt`, B = `weights/balatro-bot-moe2-pins0.pt`): `--seed-tag v4-test`; the summary adds wins per sim-hour and its bootstrap bound.

### Routine

- **The controller** `tools\balatro.ps1 <command>` wraps setup and routine jobs from PowerShell: `check`, `lock`/`unlock` (stop Steam updating the game), `bundle` (extract the game's Lua into `balatro_bundle.zip`), `setup` (build the Linux side and run every check), `train`, `stop`, `status`, `watch`, `verify` (replay every published route on the untouched game), `publish` (add new verified wins to `wins/`, update the tally, commit, push), and the save commands. `help` lists them.
- **Record the machine**: `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\sysinfo.ps1` writes hardware, Windows, WSL, GPU driver, CUDA and package versions to `balatro-work\sysinfo-<date>.txt` (no host or user names).
- **Record the Python packages**: `wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash -lc "~/balatro/venv/bin/pip freeze"` (the source of `requirements-lock.txt`).
- **Diagnose a machine crash** (Windows went down under training): `Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddHours(-4)} | ? { $_.Id -in 41,1001,1074,6008 -or $_.ProviderName -match 'WHEA|Thermal' } | Format-List TimeCreated,Id,ProviderName,Message`. 1074 is a requested restart, 1001 a bugcheck (blue screen) with its code, 41 without 1074 an unclean shutdown, WHEA a hardware error. The crashes on 2026-11-04 were bugcheck 0x20001 (hypervisor, I/O MMU) after an ASUS driver update; the driver was rolled back and Windows Update driver installs were turned off (`docs/REPRODUCE.md`, "The training machine").
- **Delete merged branches on GitHub** (from the Linux clone, which has push credentials): `wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -e bash -lc 'cd ~/balatro/balatro-headless && git fetch -q --prune origin && git branch -r --merged origin/main | grep -v -e HEAD -e origin/main$ | sed s#origin/## | xargs git push origin --delete'`.

- **Scan seeds for naneinf openings**: `wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 -- bash -lc "cd ~/balatro/balatro-headless/naneinf && . ~/balatro/venv/bin/activate && BALATRO_SRC=~/balatro/local/source python3 scan.py --check"`, then the same with `--n 200000 --workers 2 --out /mnt/c/Users/<you>/balatro-work/naneinf_hits.jsonl` in place of `--check`. `. ~/balatro/venv/bin/activate` loads the venv; `BALATRO_SRC` tells the harness where the game's Lua source is.

### Past runs

Each past run's code is kept in the commit it launched from, tagged `run-<run>`: `ARCHIVE.md` lists the tags, launchers and results. `git worktree add /tmp/old run-moe2` gives that tree back exactly.

- **Compare the experts from the same positions** (`analysis/paired_experts.py`, mixture-of-experts runs): `wsl bash -lc "cd ~/balatro/balatro-headless/analysis && . ~/balatro/venv/bin/activate && python3 paired_experts.py /mnt/c/Users/<you>/balatro-work/runs/moe2/pins0.pt --src ~/balatro/local/source --seeds 200 --handoff-antes 3,4,5 --workers 2 --out /mnt/c/Users/<you>/balatro-work/paired_moe2.jsonl"`.
- **Read GPU state**: `wsl bash -lc "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,clocks.sm,clocks_throttle_reasons.active,memory.used,memory.total,power.draw --format=csv"`.

Limits of this machine that shape the commands: the GPU (RTX 4050 Laptop) has 6 GB of its own memory. Past that, WSL's driver spills into system memory and updates slow ~10x, so the trainer caps PyTorch at 90% of the card (`--gpu-mem-fraction`) and splits a minibatch that doesn't fit. `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments` crashes under WSL and must not be set. Under sustained load the laptop heat-throttles; runs use 12 of its 16 cores.

Every result can also be checked without PowerShell: on any Linux machine with the harness built and the pinned game, `train/verify_games.py` replays saved routes.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/README.md): summary, current tally, results, research question, repository map, harness validation, versions, usage
- [Training runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/runs/README.md): one page per run (v1 → v4): what it was, what was registered and scored for it, what it left behind, and how to take out one run's routes
- [Closed hypotheses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/closed_hypotheses.md): where every registered hypothesis ended (scored, void, closed unscored) and which are still open
- [Pre-registered hypotheses and results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/hypotheses.md): every prediction, test window and result, dated, including corrections
- [Model card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/models.md): the released models, their training, evaluation and hashes
- [System card, moe2-pins0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/system_card_moe2.md): the released mixture of experts: how it routes, how it was trained, what it does and doesn't do
- [moe2 evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/moe2_evaluation.md): the run's evals, training curves, experts and open questions
- [Model design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/model_v1.md): observation encoding, action scoring, PPO, reward and shaping
- [Reproduction guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/REPRODUCE.md): from a Steam copy of Balatro to a training bot and checked routes
- [Proof by construction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/proof.md): a published route replayed to the game's own win, and the save-progress ledger
- [Won-game analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/docs/won_games_analysis.md): what the bot learned and didn't, tested against baselines
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/CHANGELOG.md): every change, dated

## Data

- [Beaten seeds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/wins/README.md): format of the public record; routes in `wins/routes.jsonl`, the list in `wins/beaten_seeds.csv`, final-boss near misses in `wins/near_misses.jsonl`
- [Released weights](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/weights/README.md): the model files; the model card says how to watch one play a seed
- [naneinf](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/naneinf/README.md): what counts, what the bot still needs, community seeds checked on this version, the seed scanner

## Code

- [harness/](https://github.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/tree/main/harness): headless boot, replay validator, the playable environment (`env.lua`, `env.py`), its checks, fuzzing, the differential accuracy check
- [train/](https://github.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/tree/main/train): model, PPO trainer and launchers, publishing and verifying wins, exporting weights, playing a seed
- [tools/](https://github.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/tree/main/tools): Windows PowerShell controller, game bundling, update lock, training watcher, WSL setup
- [tests/](https://github.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/tree/main/tests): logged real-game runs (gameplay data only) and check scripts

## Optional

- [Analysis scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bapbapbapbap/balatro-headless/main/analysis/README.md): the won-game analysis, the re-solve test, and the paired expert comparison
